# input: the Bash command, or the tool_input JSON when tool is set. __MAIN__ and __DEV__ name repos checked out on main and develop; __FEAT__ is on issue/9-x with a local main; __CFG__ is on develop with remote.origin.push = refs/heads/develop:refs/heads/main. A literal \n is a newline.

input: git push origin develop && git push origin main
git subtree push -P dist origin gh-pages
gh -R o/r pr create --base develop --title x
gh pr merge 4 --squash && gh pr merge 5 --squash
gh api graphql -f query='{ viewer { login } }'

gh api repos/o/r/pulls -f base=develop -f head=x -f title=t

gh pr create --base develop --title x --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
--base staging Non-Blocking gh pr merge 5 gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/pulls/5/merge
EOF
)"

existing_pr=$(gh pr list --head "docs/changelog-x" --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty' 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$existing_pr" ]; then
  echo "CHANGELOG PR already open: #$existing_pr"
else
  # PR title: the same versioned / version-free form as the commit message above.
  gh pr create \n    --base develop \n    --title "docs: v1.2.0" \n    --body "$(cat <<'EOF'

~~~~

  - none

EOF
)"
fi
